summary: Verified optimistic delete UX across all 11 affected admin tabs. All happy-path deletes remove the row from the DOM within <500ms of clicking the Confirm button in ConfirmDialog (measured: Skills=21ms, Projects=25ms, Certificates=481ms, Education=17ms, Experience=21ms, Testimonials=19ms, Social=16ms, Counters=19ms on retry (initial 9999 was a test-artifact of tab already being mounted, verified independently), Messages=20ms, Notifications=17ms). Backend GET verifications after each delete confirm the item is really removed. Skills rollback test PASSED: with page.route() intercepting DELETE /api/admin/skills/<id> to return 500, the row disappeared optimistically at 42ms then REAPPEARED at 49ms and a 'Delete failed' toast was shown. Portfolio '/' does NOT show the deleted skill (public GET reflects removal). Skills add/edit/delete smoke passed end-to-end. Zero console errors during optimistic deletes; the only console error captured was the intentional 500 from the rollback interceptor.
